evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/contexts/WebSocketContext.tsx:72 - categoryToQueryKeys maps the voting notification category to `votes: ['votes']`. The map KEY `votes` is correct (backend NotificationCategory::Votes serializes to the string "votes" - confirmed at backend/crates/common/src/notifications/mod.rs:83 and as_str() => "votes" at :116), but the VALUE `['votes']` is the query-cache root to invalidate, and no live voting query is cached under `votes`.

frontend/packages/api-client/src/voting/hooks.ts:24 - the voting query factory is `votingKeys = { all: ['voting'] as const, ... }`. The voting UI uses it: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/voting/pages/VotingPage.tsx:8,42 imports and calls `useVotes` from @ppt/api-client, whose cache keys all descend from `['voting']`. So the live voting list/detail caches sit under the `voting` root, not `votes`.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/App.tsx:101-108 - handleEntityEvent (the onEntityEvent consumer wired into WebSocketProvider at :116) invalidates each resolved key verbatim: `for (const key of queryKeys) queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [key] })`. Full traced path: server pushes `notification.created` with payload.category="votes" -> WebSocketContext.tsx:354-359 resolves categoryToQueryKeys['votes']=['votes'] and calls onEntityEvent('notification.created', ['notifications','votes'], ...) -> App.tsx invalidates `['notifications']` (hits) and `['votes']` (prefix-matches NOTHING; the live root is `['voting']`). Net effect: a voting notification refreshes the notification bell but the voting list/detail stays stale until it happens to refetch for another reason. The map's own docstring (:60-67) explicitly names this failure mode ('A missing key silently degrades to the notifications-only fallback, so the corresponding entity feed goes stale on push').
